script.title: PARALLEL PARKING PRACTICE
script.scene_zh: 安靜街邊 · 練路邊停車
script.story_hook: Maya parks for the first time before her driving test.
script.intro_zh: 麥雅在考照前，第一次由教練陪著在街邊練路邊停車。
script.welcome_en: Welcome to today's street scene. You'll hear real parking instructions.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎來到今天的街頭場景，你會聽到真實的停車教學。
script.outro: And she parked it! Slow wheels beat fast nerves. See you next time.
script.outro_zh: 她真的停進去了！慢而穩，勝過心慌。下次見。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line, nice and slow.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們放慢速度，逐句跟讀一次。
script.char_a_description: a young woman in her early twenties, straight black bob with honey highlights, denim jacket over a white tee, small gold hoop earrings, slim build, nervous but focused expression
script.char_b_description: a middle-aged man with a graying beard and thinning brown hair under a navy cap, wire-frame glasses, high-visibility instructor vest over a plaid shirt, stocky build, calm patient expression

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, this is the space, right?
dialogue.zh: 好，就是這個車位，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's it. Take your time.
dialogue.zh: 就是這個，你慢慢來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm nervous. My test is Thursday.
dialogue.zh: 我好緊張，週四就要考照了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Breathe. You've done this twice already.
dialogue.zh: 深呼吸，你已經練過兩次了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I line up with his mirror?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ɑɪ ˈlaɪn ʌp wɪð ɪz ˈmɪɹɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我要跟他的後視鏡齊平嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost. Match your mirror to his.
dialogue.zh: 差不多了，讓你的鏡對他的鏡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like this? Um, then I turn the wheel?
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ðɪs ʌm ðɛn aɪ tɚn ðə ˈwiːl/
dialogue.zh: 像這樣？嗯，然後打方向盤？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, wheel all the way right.
dialogue.zh: 對，方向盤完全往右打。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Whoa, he's waiting behind me.
dialogue.zh: 哇，後面有車在等我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ignore him. Slow is smooth here.
dialogue.zh: 別理他，在這裡慢就是順。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, backing up... am I crooked?
dialogue.zh: 好，在倒車了……我歪了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Straighten out. A little left now.
dialogue.zh: 回正，現在方向盤往左一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I hit the curb just now?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd aɪ hɪt ðə ˈkɜɹb dʒʌst naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我剛剛有沒有碰到路緣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, you're golden. Keep easing off.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，很完美，繼續慢慢放剎車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This gap looks way too small.
dialogue.zh: 這個車位看起來實在太小。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's tight but doable. Trust your mirrors.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts taɪt bət ˈduəbəl tɹʌst jɚ ˈmɪɹɚz/
dialogue.zh: 是緊，但停得進去，相信鏡子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay... oh no, too far out.
dialogue.zh: 好……噢，離路緣太遠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pull forward, start again. One clean try.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊl ˈfɔɹwɚd stɑɹt əˈɡɛn wʌn klin tɹaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 往前開，重新來，這次一次到位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turning... watching the cone behind me.
dialogue.zh: 打方向……我看後面的交通錐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good angle now. Straighten as you back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈæŋɡəl naʊ ˈstɹɛtən æz jə bæk/
dialogue.zh: 角度正好，倒的時候回正。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How's this? Am I close enough?
dialogue.zh: 怎麼樣？離得夠近了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're forty inches from the curb.
dialogue.zh: 你離路緣還有四十英吋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ugh, the rule says twelve.
dialogue.zh: 唉，規定是不能超過十二吋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So nudge over. Inch the wheel right.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ nʌdʒ ˈoʊvɚ ɪntʃ ðə ˈwiːl ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那再挪過去一點，方向盤慢慢往右推。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like... this? Yes, I'm in!
dialogue.zh: 這樣……這樣？有了，進去了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold the brake. Check your space.
dialogue.zh: 踩住剎車，檢查一下前後距離。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even gap front and back.
dialogue.zh: 前後的空隙都一樣大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Center in the space too, please.
dialogue.zh: 也把車在車位中間擺正。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. My hands won't stop shaking.
dialogue.zh: 好了，我的手還在發抖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First time's like that for everyone.
dialogue.zh: 每個人第一次都是這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we run it once more?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以再練一次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure. Same steps, but faster.
dialogue.zh: 好，步驟一樣，但快一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mirror, signal, angle, then back in.
dialogue.zh: 看鏡子、打方向燈、找角度、再倒車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the whole routine, actually.
dialogue.zh: 整套流程其實就這些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, my parking brake's still on.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ noʊ maɪ ˈpɑɹkɪŋ bɹeɪks stɪl ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 糟糕，我的手剎還拉著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice save. Catch that on the test.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs seɪv kætʃ ðæt ɑn ðə ˈtɛst/
dialogue.zh: 發現得好，考試時也要這樣檢查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the examiner really watch mirrors?
dialogue.zh: 考官真的會一直看鏡子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Absolutely. Mirrors show a calm driver.
dialogue.zh: 當然，鏡子看得出駕駛穩不穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, that actually makes sense.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，這樣說我就懂了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One more round, then coffee break.
dialogue.zh: 再練一圈，然後我們喝杯咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal. Um, was I too fast?
dialogue.zh: 成交。呃，我剛剛是不是太快？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little. Braking felt like a hiccup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪɾəl ˈbɹeɪkɪŋ fɛlt laɪk ə ˈhɪkəp/
dialogue.zh: 有一點，剎車頓頓的，像在打嗝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it, steady foot on the brake.
dialogue.zh: 懂了，腳要穩穩壓著剎車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly. That's the key thing.
dialogue.zh: 完全正確，這才是最關鍵的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, here I go.
dialogue.zh: 好，我要開始了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Back in... easy... hold it there.
dialogue.zh: 倒進去……慢……就停在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How's my distance from the curb?
dialogue.zh: 我離路緣還剩多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six inches. Textbook parallel park.
dialogue.zh: 六英吋，教科書級的路邊停車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I actually parallel parked!
dialogue.zh: 我真的自己停進路邊了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You sure did. Big day, huh?
dialogue.zh: 千真萬確，今天值得紀念啊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we park one more time on the hill?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi pɑɹk wʌn mɔɹ taɪm ɑn ðə hɪl/
dialogue.zh: 我們能在坡道上再停一次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure. Curb side uphill, so wheel left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ kɜɹb saɪd ˈʌpˌhɪl soʊ wiːl lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 好，這次上坡靠路緣，方向盤往左。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And when we're parked?
dialogue.zh: 停好之後要做什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gear in park, wheel left, brake on.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪɹ ɪn pɑɹk wiːl lɛft bɹeɪk ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 排停車檔、方向盤維持左打、拉上手剎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Test on Thursday feels way less scary.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛst ɑn ˈθɚzdeɪ filz weɪ lɛs ˈskɛɹi/
dialogue.zh: 週四的考試感覺沒那麼可怕了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You've earned it. Same time Saturday?
dialogue.zh: 這是你自己練出來的。週六同一時間？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal! Coffee's on me today.
dialogue.zh: 成交！今天的咖啡我請。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll bring my biggest mug, then. See you, Maya.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl bɹɪŋ maɪ ˈbɪɡəst mʌɡ ðɛn si ju ˈmajə/
dialogue.zh: 那我就帶我最大的馬克杯。週六見，麥雅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, coach. Seriously, thank you.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝教練，真的是感謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're welcome. Drive safe home.
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，回家開車小心。

script.youtube_title_en: I Actually Parallel Parked - My First Real Parallel Parking Lesson
script.youtube_description:
「I actually parallel parked!」第一次路邊停車，原來可以這樣聽、這樣說。這一集是 60 句完整美式英文對話：安靜街邊，考前練習，教練一步一步帶著開。

你會聽到：
- 對齊後視鏡當參考點（Do I line up with his mirror?）
- 倒車時的方向盤口令（Wheel all the way right. Straighten as you back.）
- 離路緣幾吋才合格（You're forty inches from the curb.）
- 停車收尾動作（Gear in park, wheel left, brake on.）

一個小插曲、一次重來、最後一次完美入庫。整個場景只有一段對話，自然推進，不會跳出場景。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，先聽懂、再開口，不用背，多聽就會用。

適合正在準備駕照、或想在國外用英文處理日常大小事的 A2 初級學習者。

喜歡這類沉浸式情境英文，請按訂閱並開啟小鈴鐺，每週更新新的場景。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish

The second half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so the phrases stick without memorizing.

Made for A2 learners who want to handle everyday life abroad in English.

考照前，你敢第一次把車倒進兩個車中間嗎？
聽得出「往右打到底」和「回正」的差別嗎？
這一集帶大家走進一條安靜的街邊：學生麥雅在教練指導下，第一次完成路邊停車。

你會聽到：
